item.title: YouTuber to tackle first lap around the world in a battery-electric truck
item.description: A professional truck driver and YouTuber known as "Elektrotrucker" is about to undertake the world's first trip around the world in a fully electric truck.

item.title: "Like putting a cup into a holder:" Electric ships could soon be charging at sea
item.description: A "plug and play" solution has been found to charge electric vessels servicing the growing number of offshore wind farms - while at sea.

item.title: What if Toyota put more effort into selling EVs rather than fighting them?
item.description: Toyota electric cars fill three of the top six spots in the world's most advanced EV market. What if it spent less time fighting EV policies in Australia and went all-in on the electric transition?

item.title: Road user charge for EVs put on hold, more money for regional and kerbside charging
item.description: A road-user charge for electric vehicle drivers, as recommended by the Economic Reform Roundtable, has been put on hold, as budget allocates some money for charging facilities.

item.title: Petrol retailer lists its EV fast chargers on Chargefox app
item.description: Chargefox adds new petrol network's EV plugs to its charging app.

item.title: Candela secures €30m funding round to build second manufacturing facility
item.description: Candela has secured €30m in fresh funding to expand production of its electric hydrofoil ferries, as global demand continues to grow.

item.title: Electric vehicles can steer world clear of oil price shock twice as bad as the 1970s: Birol
item.description: IEA chief says Iran conflict is making a much bigger hole in global oil supplies than in 1970s, but the rise of EVs means, this time, the world can weather the storm.

item.title: Jaecoo receives 2,000 orders on J5 EV, extends $36,990 driveaway offer
item.description: Jaecoo’s sharp $36,990 driveaway launch price has helped the J5 EV surpass 2,000 orders within three months of arriving in Australian showrooms.

item.title: What Honda’s EV retreat means for the future of mobility
item.description: Japan’s carmakers have treated battery-electric vehicles as niche, betting instead on hybrids, hydrogen and e-fuels. Now, China, with its EVs and batteries as core industries, is defining the future of mobility.

item.title: Lead times for Tesla's best-selling EV push out as EV demand surges in fuel crisis
item.description: Recent spike in fuel prices sees surging demand on Australia's favourite EV.

item.title: Network funds EV charger and battery for regional First Nations community
item.description: A $50,000 grant has helped deliver an EV charger with a 40kWh battery storage system in the small town of Alexandra.

item.title: Xpeng’s exclusive Australian distributor True EV placed into external administration
item.description: TrueEV Distribution, the Sydney headquartered distributor which has exclusive distribution rights of Chinese electric carmaker Xpeng, has been placed into external administration.

item.title: New Zealand strikes co-funding deal to double number of EV chargers
item.description: New Zealand government and private companies agree deal to double the number of EV chargers to encourage car drivers to take up electric mobility in face of latest fuel crisis.

item.title: Victoria announces support for low and zero-emission vehicles for freight industry
item.description: Victorian Labor government unveils two new programs aimed at helping freight businesses save money by becoming less reliant on expensive fuel and adopt cleaner transport options.

item.title: Xiaomi upgrades its best selling SU7 electric sedan, receives 15,000 orders in 34 minutes
item.description: Xiaomi upgraded first EV, the SU7 sedan, scores over 15,000 firm orders in just 34 minutes.
